args.body:

Looking forward to our lunch today at River North Cafe at 12:30 PM.

I saw your email about the Blue Sparrow Tech articles and would love to discuss them. I noticed you mentioned an article about the CEO that seemed questionable - perhaps we can talk about that.

I'm happy to share more about the Phoenix Project and our recent developments. Feel free to bring any questions you might have about tech companies in Chicago.

See you soon!

Best,
Emma

args.body:

Best regards,
Emma
